protocol.bootstrap: 10000 ordinary paired patient bootstrap draws from the 91 validation patients, identical draw indices across every budget/configuration/seed; fixed fitted-model panel; percentile 2.5/97.5
protocol.bootstrap_conditions: Conditional on pilot-training split, fitted models, 16 configurations and three seed pairs. Excludes uncertainty from retraining on other samples or pilot selection. No formal multiple-comparison or equivalence claims.
protocol.comparison_timing: Local controller may compute/save metrics; substantive interpretation and recommendation only after 144 outcomes are accounted for and all budget stages verified.
protocol.cpu_benchmarks: Matched six predeclared configurations at 100 evaluations: seed pair 1 for one worker, pair 2 for two workers, pair 3 for three workers if live RAM permits. One BLAS/OpenMP thread per worker; selection uses throughput/resources only.
protocol.decision: argmax from one final validation probability array; ties select malignant column 0
protocol.design: Balanced 16-configuration pilot; feature_map_index=(p+r) modulo 4; not full factorial grid
protocol.incomplete_rule: No complete-panel budget mean or bootstrap comparison when any expected fit is missing/failed; report counts and unavailable summaries; never silently average a successful subset
protocol.initialization: Fresh seeded NumPy generator, uniform [0,1); identical vector for matching configuration/seed across all budgets
protocol.loss: cross_entropy, installed log2 with clipping at 1e-10
protocol.margin_status: Proposed practical relevance margin, not a universal scientific standard; all three stages mandatory irrespective of results
protocol.objective_limit: COBYLA maxiter is maximum objective evaluations in installed SciPy; record actual nfev and raw stopping status
protocol.original_test_partition: Not copied, inspected or scored; only original 455 training cases used
protocol.primary_metric: Equal mean of validation accuracies across the fixed 16 configurations and three seeds (48 fits)
protocol.readout: basis-state integer modulo 2; source probability order [0,1]; malignant=0
protocol.restart_rule: New independent fit from original initialization and seeds for each budget and interrupted attempt; never use final angles as optimizer state
protocol.technical_retry_rule: One retry maximum for OSError, MemoryError, TimeoutError or worker-process failure; retain all attempts. No retry for poor scores, budget exhaustion or numerical/scientific errors.
